rationale: Quinbrook defines Primergy as its 100%-owned portfolio company and identifies Ash Creek as one of Primergy's projects. Regulatory evidence identifies Ash Creek Solar LLC as the project company beneath Primergy Solar LLC. No separate Ash Creek fund, co-investment, manager-level governance package or later equity transfer was found.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Ash Creek Solar PortCo record into Primergy Solar.
Preserve Ash Creek Solar LLC as an operating 408 MWac project with a 2021 Primergy acquisition milestone and 2025 commissioning milestone.
Do not create separate companies for Sam Switch Solar, any proposed battery concept or subordinate project entities.
Do not treat project lenders, tax-equity investors, Microsoft or SOLV Energy as PortCo owners.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact 2021 acquisition closing date, consideration and predecessor transfer chain are not publicly disclosed.
The immediate parent above Ash Creek Solar LLC and exact sponsor/tax-equity economics are not publicly disclosed.
The unnamed telecom tax-equity investor and exact contractual commercial-operation date are not publicly disclosed.
